resources.string: Termux is not installed.\n\nInstall Termux from F-Droid, then run qemu-ios/scripts/android/setup.sh in it.
This app needs permission to run commands in Termux to start the device.

Could not start the device through Termux:
%1$s

Run setup.sh in Termux and make sure allow-external-apps = true is set in ~/.termux/termux.properties.
The device did not start.\n\nIn Termux, check: device status and device log (or, for the qemu-ios iPod: ipod status, tail ~/ipod/ipod.log)
